title: Ziyarat of Imam Jafar Sadiq
urduTitle: زیارت امام جعفر صادق علیہ السلام
intro: The individual visitation of Imam Jafar al-Sadiq, the sixth Imam, whose resting place is in Baqi.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Jafar Sadiq with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Leader of mankind
Peace be upon you, O firmest handhold

blocks.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبْلَ اللَّهِ الْمَتِينُ
blocks.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalayka yā ḥabla Allāhi al-matīn
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O strong rope of Allah
Peace be upon you, O His clear light
Peace be upon you, O Truthful one

blocks.arabic: جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، خَازِنُ الْعِلْمِ، الدَّاعِي
blocks.transliteration: Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, khāzin al-ʿilm, ad-dāʿī
blocks.english: Ja'far, son of Muhammad, the keeper of knowledge, the caller

blocks.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا جَعَلْتَهُ مَعْدِنَ كَلَامِكَ وَوَحْيِكَ، وَخَازِنَ عِلْمِكَ،
blocks.transliteration: Allāhumma kamā jaʿaltahu maʿdina kalāmika wa waḥyika, wa khāzina ʿilmik
blocks.english: O Allah, just as You made him the source of Your words and revelations, and the keeper of Your knowledge,

blocks.transliteration: wa lisāna tawḥīdik, wa wāliya amrik
blocks.english: And the tongue of Your oneness, and the guardian of Your command,

blocks.transliteration: wa mustaḥfiẓa dīnik, faṣalli ʿalayhi afḍala
blocks.english: And the protector of Your religion, then send blessings upon him— the best

blocks.arabic: مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْصِيَائِكَ
blocks.transliteration: mā ṣallayta ʿalā aḥadin min awṣiyāʾik
blocks.english: That You have sent upon any of Your successors (awliyāʾ)
And proofs, truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام جعفر صادق علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
